confidence_notes: Low confidence: holistic memory-based estimates, not checked against live menus or listings. Argentina's inflation and peso exchange rate have been highly volatile, so July 2026 levels could plausibly be 30-40% off, most for accommodation and bar drinks; remembered prices were carried forward assuming local price growth roughly offset peso changes since 2025. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor (cocktail about 2x beer, wine about 1.2x beer) because direct bar-price knowledge is weak. The RBA value came from search excerpts, not a direct read of the live table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Latin American capital-city basis: hotel and mid-range dining levels were loosely benchmarked against Santiago and Montevideo; bar and inexpensive-meal levels reflect Buenos Aires' own local pricing pattern. July is winter, a low season for many foreign visitors but with domestic school holidays, so no large seasonal discount was applied.
